bug_semantics: For a private 802.1X (WPA-Enterprise) profile (connection.permissions / priv->private_user), NetworkManager already reads FILE-typed cert/key properties as the owning user and hands them to wpa_supplicant as blobs. 802-1x.ca-path and 802-1x.phase2-ca-path are directories, so they cannot be blobs and were still emitted as raw ca_path/ca_path2 strings. With no ca-cert set, wpa_supplicant trusts that directory alone and still reports the authentication server as verified. An unprivileged local user with settings.modify.own can therefore point a private profile at an attacker-controlled CA directory, bypass server certificate validation, and steal EAP credentials via a rogue AP. CWE-863; incomplete CVE-2025-9615 private_user restriction, not a withdrawn advisory.
flaw_origin: The private_user restriction was first written in e85cc46d0b36cdba50fe8411cc93d55a49ebfccf (Beniamino Galvani, 2025-09-23, committed 2025-12-12 on the issue1809/CVE-2025-9615 series). That commit added priv->private_user and converted ca_cert, client_cert, private_key and their phase2 FILE-typed siblings to blobs (g_return_val_if_fail if a private connection still had a leftover path), but it did not touch the pre-existing add_string_val(..., "ca_path"/"ca_path2") emit in nm_supplicant_config_add_setting_8021x. Immediate parent a1928b4459a771acbc943dfd41ed3c3426ddb4a6 has no private_user field at all. Later 8d8edda3f's NM_SETTING_PARAM_CERT_KEY_FILE catalog and ddb783fdb's pac-file blob path also omitted the directory properties. The 2009 ca-path feature (e5ed391f) is not this BIC: this CVE is the hole in the new private_user control, not the original path emit.

reasoning: CVE-2026-19685 is a real, published Red Hat CNA issue (CWE-863), not withdrawn. After CVE-2025-9615, private 802.1X files must not be re-read from disk by the root supplicant; they are passed as blobs. Directories cannot be blobs, so ca-path/phase2-ca-path kept emitting a user-chosen filesystem path. With no ca-cert, that path is the entire trust store and a local unprivileged owner of a private profile can MITM WPA-Enterprise. The complete fix a8e87381 (MR 2513) rejects those properties unless ca_path_override (system-ca-certs) is set, and is cherry-picked to 1.58.1 as 15aa1a896. The BIC is the smallest commit that first wrote the incomplete private_user control: e85cc46d, which added priv->private_user and FILE-typed blob conversion while leaving the ca_path emit unchanged. That is not a move, squash, revert, or release commit; parent a1928b4459 has no private_user at all, so the omission exists only once the new restriction is introduced. Pre-2009 ca-path emit and later CERT_KEY_FILE/pac-file follow-ups are not this BIC. AI is judged only from that BIC commit object: human NetworkManager maintainers Galvani/Huguet, no AI trailers. The 2026 fix author is irrelevant to BIC attribution.
